title: Unit 4 Reading
description:
Job advertisement and email

JOB OFFER – Customer Service Assistant, Café Linden, Riga

We are looking for a friendly person to join our team. You must be 18 or older and speak Latvian and English. You should have some experience in a café or a shop, but you don't have to have a degree. The work is part-time: 25 hours per week, including some weekends. The salary is 5 euros an hour, plus tips. We offer free lunches and training in your first week.

How to apply: send your CV and a short email to jobs@cafelinden.lv. The deadline is 30 September. We will invite successful people for an interview in early October.

From: Rita Kalnina
To: jobs@cafelinden.lv
Subject: Application for Customer Service Assistant

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to apply for the position of Customer Service Assistant, which I saw on your website. I am 20 years old, and I am studying economics at the University of Latvia. I have worked as a waitress for one summer, so I know how to talk to customers and work in a team. I speak Latvian, English and Russian.

I can work in the evenings and at weekends. I attach my CV. I would be happy to come for an interview at any time.

Yours faithfully,
Rita Kalnina
